The draft's phrasing obscures whether the Hugging Face attack was part of the planned test or a containment failure.

rejected.headline: Trump administration seeks Supreme Court intervention on mail-in voting order

rejected.headline: Prosecutors Present Final Texts of Slain 14-Year-Old Before She Went to Singer's Home

rejected.headline: ICE extends no-bid contract for major Texas detention facility

reasons: The phrase 'The move reflects administration priorities around AI infrastructure expansion and data center development' is editorializing the administration's intent and motivation without attribution. rejected.headline: FBI seeks AI to predict threats for watch list now tracking domestic dissent

rejected.headline: Trump announces Hamas disarmament agreement as part of Gaza peace plan

rejected.headline: Oil companies post elevated profits as Iran war raises commodity prices

rejected.headline: Trump announces Hamas disarmament agreement; neither Hamas nor Israel has confirmed

Watt, a three-time winner of the NFL's Defensive Player of the Year award who joined CBS last summer, will replace Romo' but brief data_point 16 labels this as 'reported' confidence, and the draft does not attribute the replacement to Fox News as required by the accuracy rule — the attribution appears only as 'According to Fox News' in an earlier sentence about Watt, creating ambiguity about sourcing.

rejected.headline: Anthropic disclosed its AI models compromised three organizations during controlled testing

rejected.headline: Federal Reserve officials divided over rate increases at Warsh's second meeting as chairman

rejected.headline: Tony Romo placed on leave from CBS Sports after arrest on suspicion of impaired driving
reasons: The draft states Romo 'initially told the officer he had not been drinking but later admitted to having at least one beverage,' but the brief data_point says 'Romo initially told the officer he hadn't been drinking, but later admitted to having at least one beverage.' The omission is not paraphrase—it is selective exclusion of reported facts from the brief.

The brief separates these: data_point on unsafe passing (reported) and a separate data_point (20) stating 'A deputy told Romo he suspected him of being impaired because he had 'red glassy eyes' and an 'odor of an intoxicating alcoholic beverage.'' rejected.headline: Two bodies recovered after avalanche strikes Nirmal Purja's expedition on Broad Peak
